eli: heads-up — nightly microbench sweep flagged an unexpected latency spike (p50 +12%, p99 +20%) for the candidate kernel set on Ampere at seqlen=1024 :eyes:
bench-bot: auto-report attached: https://ci.internal/bench/3512345678 (summary below)
bench-bot: ampere | candidate-v3 | seqlen=1024 | bs=1 | p50=42.1ms (+13%) | p99=85.0ms (+20%) | kv-miss-rate=0.27
anika: do we have the exact repro command? can run locally in perf-lab.
sam: repro command (perf-lab):
```
./bench_runner --model gpt-like-35b --kernel-set candidate-v3 --bs 1,4 --seqlen 128,512,1024 --arch ampere --repeat 30 --collect-trace=triton,kvcache
```

maria: hmm looking at traces, there are repeated KV cache evictions around the 1024 boundary — candidate-v3 picks a tiled-attention kernel that thrashes L2 for midseq patterns. kv-miss-rate spikes to ~0.25 which matches bench-bot.
eli: interesting — autotuner heuristic currently uses median seqlen + 2x IQR to pick kernel families, so the long tail might be forcing a more general kernel that is bad for midseq.
anika: suggestion: make the pick aware of kv-miss-rate and prefer streaming-optimized kernel when kv-miss-rate > 0.2. That should reduce evictions.
sam: quick experiment: switched runtime flag `--prefer-stream-kernels-on-kvmiss` and reran one node — p50 dropped back to 37.0ms, p99 68.5ms (numbers approximate).
perf-bot: nightly-diff: baseline candidate-v2 -> candidate-v3: seqlen=1024 p50 delta +12.4% (regression), global avg p50 +1.8%
eli: OK can we turn this into a triage ticket? label: perf-regression, priority P1 for next sprint. include repro, trace, and a proposed autotune patch.
anika: I'll open PR to autotuner to incorporate kv-miss gating and a safe fallback policy (prefer-stream if kv-miss > 0.2 and p50 delta > 5%). also adding an integration test for seqlen buckets around 768-1536.
maria: also raising a test for KV-cache life-cycle in the harness — currently harness uses a synthetic prompt pattern that underestimates eviction churn. need to add a mixed-length workload generator.
eli: action items: 1) anika PR for autotune (owner: anika) 2) maria add mixed-length generator to microbench harness (owner: maria) 3) sam run perf-lab canary with flag for 24h and post traces (owner: sam).
bench-bot: scheduled a focused nightly sweep (seqlen 512, 768, 1024, 1536) for candidate-v3 on ampere at 03:30 UTC, will post results. :calendar:
sam: noted, will watch for flakiness. if we see variance >3% across two runs we should gate candidate-v3 in CI. :thumbsup:
eli: thanks — we should also add a small CI probe that runs the repro command on PRs that touch kernel-selection heuristics. prevents regressions slipping in.
anika: will include that in the PR. planning to keep change minimal (threshold + unit test).
maria: rough ETA: harness change + new workload generator by EOD tomorrow, autotuner PR by EOD +2.
eli: cool. keep updates in this thread. :rocket:
